data.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
data.summary_raw: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

data.title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
data.summary_raw: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

data.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
data.summary_raw: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

data.title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
data.summary_raw: The Democratic ranking member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations asked Paolo Ardoino for records related to a reported deal between Tether and Nxum.
